notes: The only list of sources `npm run prompts:fetch` reads. A source is used only when its dataset card, read from the Hugging Face API on each run, declares a licence in the allow-list of the script (cc0-1.0, cc-by-4.0, apache-2.0, mit) equal to `expected_licence`. `columns.prompt` names the one column that becomes the prompt; only the columns named here are ever read (a lyrics column is never named). Not used, and why, in docs/PROMPT_PRESETS.md.

sources.notes: Text-only metadata (never the images): the prompts of a CC0 collection of Stable Diffusion generations. The authors ask for a threshold on their NSFW scores.
198 prompts in 14 categories, written with ChatGPT and by hand. The category is a tag.

sources.check: Off by the owner (2026-11-13), not because of the licence (the card says CC-BY-4.0 and the gate would accept it) but because of where the prompts come from: they were written by Suno's users and nothing here can check that the uploader could license them. Turn it on only for strictly local use, never in a bundle that is shared or published.
sources.notes: Style descriptions and tags only; the lyrics column (`prompt_letras`) and the song's title are not named, so they are never read. OFF (owner, 2026-11-13), not because of the licence (the card says CC-BY-4.0 and would pass) but because of the provenance: the prompts were written by Suno's users and nothing here can check that the uploader could license them. Turn it on only for strictly local use, never in a bundle that is shared or published.
